htmlBody:
Energy and labor risks are real — and they are not the whole ocean. Today’s care is the Invisible Frontier: Gates’s linear world as the water, our Goldilocks ship floating, navigating, and drawing from it. Catalog framing — not a dunk, and not a prophecy.

If you want a map for that: Gates’s warnings, our Goldilocks ship. For the three-dome stage map: Three nested domes — one Goldilocks stage.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
